Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual

Labels: Sanity, can_be_automated

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Board module of the boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4236 Box Module - Board - Basic operations - Contextual scope definition

Three tasks are visible in the backlog

   Expected: The Add task dropdown is opened in the left, top corner with options:

* Create task
* Manage scope definition
7. Click on Manage scope definition option
   Expected: Contextual Scope definition modal is displayed. The following elements are visible:

* Project
* Board

8. Click on Advanced option button
